english.notes:
(i) Section 45 of the Gambling Act 2005 provides that "child" means an individual who is less than 16 years old, and "young person" means an individual who is aged 16 or 17.
(ii) Section 50(2) of the Gambling Act 2005 provides that subsection (1) does not apply to the provision of facilities in connection with
(a) private or non-commercial gaming,
(b) private or non-commercial betting,
(c) a lottery,
(d) football pools, or
(e) prize gaming at a travelling fair in accordance with section 292.
(iii) Section 63 of the Gambling Act 2005 provides the defence of reasonable belief about a person's age.
